author: Traditional-Area1456
selftext:
I also opened a link you can use to support me since stripe is not available in my country, [https://revolut.me/pilsner110?currency=EUR&amount=100](https://revolut.me/pilsner110?currency=EUR&amount=100)

comments.author: same-mistake-twice
comments.body: Good post OP, begging for money usually works.

replies.author: Traditional-Area1456
replies.body: hahahah well I'm not really begging, I'm trying to push my game further. I know it comes off as just random begging but I really would like to just get the gears spinning

replies.author: PhantomZenithOrigin
replies.body: If you stick out a cup and point at it and it says 'please money here', then you're begging.  Also your model looks bad.  It doesn't look retro, it simply looks poorly created.

replies.author: Traditional-Area1456
replies.body: It'll look better in game, a pixel shader is applied, thank you for the feedback though, I would gladly make the models look much better if I could take it financially :)

replies.author: PhantomZenithOrigin
replies.body: Let's see it with that pixel shader applied.

comments.author: Templeshooter
comments.body: Did you generate this in blender via MCP?

replies.author: Traditional-Area1456
replies.body: nope, I generated it through 6.1 and an example image that I made using gpt image

replies.author: Traditional-Area1456
replies.body: blender was used to make it though

replies.author: Templeshooter
replies.body: So you generated the concept picture, and then you gave it to gpt (cli or in vscode) and it connected to your blender to make a model from this concept? it is kind of high quality, i expected less from a 3d model generated from pure math
